openapi.title: Temporal Cloud Ops API

auth.selected: Temporal Cloud API key resolved only by the trusted Bearer connection adapter
auth.origin_matching: fixed saas-api.tmprl.cloud host; per_org vendor-tag matching is deliberately disabled

source_decision.reason: Temporal namespaces, Cloud projects, identities, access assignments, audit sinks, and asynchronous operations are control-plane resources. Temporal Cloud projects group namespaces and permissions; they are not user-work projects with an honest canonical work projection.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The OpenAPI applies Bearer API-key authentication once at the top level instead of repeating it on every operation, and Temporal RBAC can grant broad account control.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Verifies the inherited security scheme and absence of operation overrides for all 87 routes, keeps the credential inside one encrypted Bearer connection, fixes the host, and requires approval on every mutation.

audit_findings_folded.finding: POST /cloud/api-keys returns a one-time API key token that the provider explicitly labels secret and non-retrievable.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Retains the complete credential-lifecycle capability but labels the response secret, requires destructive approval, excludes it from workflows, and records the exact route in authority evidence.

audit_findings_folded.finding: GET /cloud/billing-reports/{billingReportId} can return an expiring billing-report download URL that functions as bearer-like capability material.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Returns only the documented JSON metadata without following the URL, labels the response sensitive, excludes the route from workflows, and records the exact capability-bearing route in authority evidence.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Namespace, mTLS, API-key auth, connectivity, high-availability, audit-export, identity, membership, and RBAC changes can alter security or live control-plane behavior.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Classifies deletes and high-impact control-plane mutations as destructive, keeps remaining mutations admin, requires approval on every mutation, and configures no hidden retry.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Audit and workflow-history export sinks can route private operational data to external destinations.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Keeps sink validation and lifecycle operations complete but destructive and approval-gated, marks the request and response surfaces sensitive, and bundles no sink mutation workflow.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The live first-party OpenAPI is mutable and was already newer than the search-indexed API reference during authoring.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Pins the exact v0.18.0 bytes and SHA-256 and fails generation before writes on version, identity, route, auth, media, response, or pagination drift.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The OpenAPI server is the relative URL / rather than an absolute origin.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Resolves it against the official spec URL to saas-api.tmprl.cloud, emits an origin-only base, and disables per_org matching so a vendor tag cannot redirect the credential to another host.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Twenty collection operations use opaque pageToken pagination with a documented default pageSize of 100; nineteen document a maximum of 1000, while Connectivity Rules does not declare a maximum.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Owns pageSize and pageToken automatically, extracts each exact collection field, follows nextPageToken, applies max 1000 only where documented, and leaves the Connectivity Rules maximum provider-owned.

audit_findings_folded.finding: All 37 request bodies are required JSON objects with nested specifications, resource versions, maps, and integer fields.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Uses required bounded body_raw for every body so nested shapes, nulls, optimistic-concurrency values, and exact integer lexemes survive unchanged.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The API carries private control-plane inputs and outputs beyond obvious credential routes, including projects, Nexus endpoints, role definitions, failover topology, billing scope, and asynchronous operation details.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Labels all 37 request bodies and all 87 responses private, keeps every mutation approval-gated, and exposes only deliberately selected non-chat read workflows.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Two official update paths use the dotted parameter spec.name and two group filters use dotted query names; projectIds is an exploded array query parameter.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Preserves the exact flat dotted keys, emits the official path markers, keeps form/explode query semantics, and serializes projectIds as repeated query keys.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Protobuf-derived responses contain open Any and map objects whose numeric members are not statically bounded, while BillingReportDownload.fileSizeBytes is explicitly encoded as string/int64.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Parses every JSON response with unsafe integers preserved as decimal strings and sends request bodies verbatim so exact integer lexemes are never routed through JavaScript number coercion.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Temporal Cloud Projects share a name with the Recued work-entity kind but represent namespace and permission groupings, not user-work projects.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Declares no work_entity_sources and records the semantic rejection in the evidence fixture.
